senses.gloss: वैनतेय वैनतेय, i. e. वि-नता, A proper name, the wife of Kāśyapa (vb. नम्), + एय, metronym., m. Garuḍa, Vikr. 6, 6.

वैनयिक वैनयिक, i. e. विनय + इक,
 I. adj., f. की.
 1. Relating to morals or behaviour.
 2. Enforcing proper conduct.
 3. Magisterial, performed by the officers of criminal justice, Man. 7, 65.
 II. m. A war carriage.
वैनायक वैनायक, i. e. विनायक + अ, adj., f. की, Referring to, or made by, Gaṇeśa, Mālat. 1, 5.

वैनाशिक वैनाशिक, i. e. विनाश + इक, m.
 1. A dependent, a subject, a slave.
 2. An astrologer.
 3. A spider.
वैनीतक वैनीतक, i. e. वि-नीत (vb. नी), + क, m. and n. A mediate conveyance, as a porter carrying a letter.

वैन्य वैन्य, i. e. वेन + य, patronym., m.
 1. The king Pṛthu, the son of Vena (ŚKD.).
 2. The name of a deity(?), Rājat. 5, 97; 99.
